references.text: Jacob named the place Penuel (Face of God) because he had seen God face to face and yet survived, using the same expression as Gideon.
God tells Moses that no one can see His face and live, which explains Gideon's fear after seeing the angel of the Lord face to face.
Moses knew the Lord face to face, using the same expression applied to Gideon's encounter with the angel of the Lord.
Manoah expresses the same fear as Gideon after seeing the angel of the Lord, saying they will die because they have seen God.
Hagar was surprised to have seen God and yet live, a reaction similar to Gideon's.
Isaiah cries 'Woe is me' when he sees the Lord, showing the same type of fearful reaction as Gideon with his exclamation 'Oh, Lord God!'
